sloka: ततो रामो ऽभिसङ्क्रुद्धश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान् ।कृतप्रतिकृतं कर्तुं मनसा सम्प्रचक्रमे ।। ६.१०९.१० ।।
transliteration: tato rāmo 'bhisaṅkruddhaścāpamāyamya vīryavān ।kṛtapratikṛtaṁ kartuṁ manasā sampracakrame ।। 6.109.10 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Rama too stretching his bow in anger and thinking of returning back blow to Ravana and started compliance.
